title: Repair the hollow Melody Maker entity-count test without claiming a reduction
intent: F-2 read a missing attribute through getattr default 0, so the reduction assertion could not fail. Read dxf.entity_count directly, check each run against a structured ezdxf parse of its emitted DXF, and stop asserting a reduction until F-3 reports that masking was applied.
behavior_change: Test integrity only. No vectorizer algorithm, orchestrator, result model, DXF generation, OCR capability, workflow, or default API CI change. The real-plan tests remain on the vectorizer_regression marker.

diff_articulation.what_changed:
test_entity_count_reduction is now test_melody_maker_reports_entity_counts. It reads result.dxf.entity_count and checks both emitted DXFs against an ezdxf parse (LINE + LWPOLYLINE in modelspace). It does not assert masked < unmasked. Fast tests cover a missing count, an artifact mismatch, an applied reduction, an identical applied pair, and a refused comparison when applied is not true. The Melody Maker fixture uses the same two-call cache. The 2026-10-03 census is unchanged; the evidence test maps the old test id to the new name. The dogfood evidence test accepts a stored copy of the scanned regression bytes when the live file no longer matches that pin. Review follow-up: the first draft's artifact check re-ran the orchestrator's own "
LINE
" substring count over the same bytes, so it agreed with production by construction and could not fail. It now parses group-code pairs; a fast test with a TEXT entity whose value is LINE fails if the helper reverts to the substring rule. The main test uses reported_entity_count for both runs instead of an inline type check. The pipeline writes CRLF; ezdxf reads an unnormalized CRLF stream as zero entities, so the helper normalizes line endings before parsing, and a CRLF fast test fails if that normalization is removed.
diff_articulation.why: The previous assertion compared zeros and could not detect a failed mask. Claiming a reduction now would also be false, because the result does not yet report whether masking was applied.
diff_articulation.why_not_redundant: CODE-TOOL-DOGFOOD-003 classified the detector miss and left the test hollow. This order repairs the test. It does not add a detector and it does not repair F-3.
diff_articulation.what_did_not_change: edge_to_dxf.py, the orchestrator, result models, DXF generation, OCR installation, vectorizer-regression.yml, core CI marker exclusion, DETECTOR_RUNS.json hashes, defects_repaired, the dogfood sentence that neither defect was repaired, and the 2026-10-03 census.

The original draft never converted the Melody Maker PDF, so its artifact check had not run on real output. The review follow-up ran it: the structured count equals the reported count on the real masked output (223427).
On this machine masking did reduce the count (223427 vs 266359), but the test still does not assert it: the result does not report whether masking was applied, and CI lacks EasyOCR (F-3).
